mapper.update: UPDATE interview_result ir JOIN resume sr ON sr.resume_id=ir.resume_id AND sr.cycle_id=ir.cycle_id AND sr.user_id=ir.user_id SET ir.draft_created_by=IF(ir.draft_created_at IS NULL,#{operatorId},ir.draft_created_by), ir.draft_created_at=COALESCE(ir.draft_created_at,NOW()),ir.draft_updated_by=#{operatorId}, ir.draft_updated_at=NOW(),ir.draft_dept_id=#{assignedDeptId},ir.screened_draft=NULL,ir.updated_at=ir.updated_at WHERE ir.cycle_id=#{cycleId} AND ir.decision=0 AND sr.status<>5 AND ir.result_id IN #{id}
